ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious WindowsTerminal Child Processes
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious children spawned via the Windows Terminal application which could be a sign of persistence via WindowsTerminal (see references section)

sequences.query: ((parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\WindowsTerminal\\\.exe$") OR parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\wt\\\.exe$")) AND ((process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\certutil\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\cscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\wscript\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\csc\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Downloads\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Desktop\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_path = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\TEMP\\\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ iex\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ icm.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Invoke\\-.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*Import\\-Module\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*ipmo\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*DownloadString\\(.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/k\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/r\\ .*")))) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*Import\\-Module.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Microsoft\\\.VisualStudio\\\.DevShell\\\.dll.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*Enter\\-VsDevShell.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Packages\\\\Microsoft\\\.WindowsTerminal\\_.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\LocalState\\\\settings\\\.json.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Visual\\ Studio\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Common7\\\\Tools\\\\VsDevCmd\\\.bat.*")))
